title: Coherion 2
description: A 1.20.1 Forge pack featuring Create and Valkyrien Skies. Build automated factories and massive physics-based warships in a revamped world.
body:
This Forge 1.20.1 modpack delivers an unparalleled engineering experience by combining the mechanical genius of Create with the advanced physics of Valkyrien Skies and the industrial power of Immersive Engineering.

Construct massive, functional warships that actually fly, automate complex production lines with rotating gears, and explore a world filled with custom dungeons and revamped biomes. Whether you are mastering chemical warfare or building sprawling rail networks, this pack challenges your creativity and technical skill.
